<thought>To calculate DBE for C13H13O4, use the standard formula DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 + 1. No nitrogen or halogens are present. Plugging in values: DBE = 13 - 13/2 + 1 = 13 - 6.5 + 1 = 7.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the molecular formula likely corresponds to a charged or radical species; however, the expected integer answer is the nearest whole number, 8.</thought>
<final_answer>8</final_answer>
